Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface UiHostCapabilityService

public interface UiHostCapabilityService
Plugin-facing, toolkit-neutral UI contribution service.

Calls submit declarative SDK values or return semantic snapshots and registrations. The runtime owns host UI adaptation, UI-thread dispatch, placement, collision policy, and host lifecycle. Every contribution registration is normally enrolled in the caller's plugin scope; close it to withdraw the contribution early. UI permission authorizes a request, but does not make the matching provider family available. Safe-mode or fake-host retention of a descriptor is not evidence of real-host UI readiness.

Plugins must not obtain raw Swing, AWT, Cubism, native, or host-widget objects through this service.

    • contextSource

      ContextSourceSnapshot contextSource()
      Returns the current semantic source context for a UI invocation.

      The snapshot contains SDK-owned identifiers only and may cease to describe the active host context after a document or selection change.

      Returns:
      a non-null source-context snapshot
      Throws:
      CubismPermissionException - if the context-source permission is denied

    • openDialog

      Registration openDialog(DialogRequest request)
      Requests presentation of a declarative dialog.

      Closing the returned registration requests removal of the dialog contribution. A provider may be unavailable even when permission succeeds; callers must not infer native presentation merely from this registration.

      Parameters:
      request - non-null dialog descriptor
      Returns:
      a closeable registration
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if request is null
      CubismPermissionException - if the dialog-contribution permission is denied

    • confirmDialog

      boolean confirmDialog(DialogRequest request)
      Requests a yes/no confirmation for a dialog descriptor.

      Returning false means the user declined, canceled, or the host could not present a confirmation. No host widget is exposed.

      Parameters:
      request - non-null dialog descriptor
      Returns:
      true only when the user confirms
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if request is null
      CubismPermissionException - if the dialog-contribution permission is denied

    • contributeEmbeddedPanel

      Registration contributeEmbeddedPanel(EmbeddedPanelContribution contribution)
      Declares a runtime-rendered panel owned by the calling plugin.

      Panel control action IDs resolve through that plugin's action registry. The runtime owns actual docking and host widgets.

      Parameters:
      contribution - non-null panel descriptor
      Returns:
      a closeable registration that withdraws the panel
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if contribution is null
      CubismPermissionException - if the panel-contribution permission is denied
